clauses: This prominent biochemist and university teacher has significantly advanced the field of biochemistry.
Their groundbreaking research has earned them widespread international acclaim.

Throughout their career, they have been honored with the Wolf Prize in Medicine, the Canada Gairdner International Award, the Paul Ehrlich and Ludwig Darmstaedter Prize, and the Dickson Prize in Medicine.
Additionally, they were elected as a Foreign Member of the Royal Society.
Despite their extensive list of scientific accolades, they have never been awarded the Nobel Prize in Chemistry.
